title: Resolve session-orphaning and audit-event gaps during on-prem KMS rotation
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Multiple enterprise Private customers reported that after a scheduled on-prem KMS envelope rotation some long-lived SSO sessions became unusable (orphaned) and a subset of control-plane audit events covering that rotation window are missing from the tenant audit log. The issue affects private control-plane instances where HSM-enforced rotations use a two-step envelope handshake and customers configured client-side RBAC caching with long TTLs. This ticket tracks root cause analysis, an urgent patch, backfill of missing audit events, and rollout/verification for all affected Private clusters.
customer_reports: Acme Health: users unable to perform admin role escalate - sessions appear valid but control-plane rejects requests with 401 referencing stale key fingerprint
FinServe EU: audit export shows gap between 2026-03-11T22:10:00Z and 2026-03-11T22:42:00Z for rotation transactions
Nimble Retail: RBAC sync shows 'key not found' warnings during rotation, several elevated-permission actions failed to record
steps_to_repro: 1) Configure private control-plane with on-prem KMS and enable HSM envelope rotation with 2-step handshake
2) Create long-lived SSO session with RBAC cache TTL > 24h
3) Trigger scheduled rotation (or wait for automatic rotation window)
4) Observe that API requests from session tokens intermittently return 401s even though session appears active in the session store
5) Check tenant audit log export and note missing rotation-success events for the window
root_cause_summary: An edge condition in the envelope rotation handshake caused a brief transition where the control-plane recorded a new envelope fingerprint in the rotation journal but continued accepting requests against the old envelope until a late atomic commit. SSO session validation uses a cached key-fingerprint mapping; when the commit order reversed on some nodes the mapping became inconsistent and the RBAC cache did not invalidate immediately. Concurrently, the audit logger pipeline dropped a small number of rotation events because the log envelope header schema changed in the same deploy and the downstream consumer rejected those messages, producing a silent gap.
fix_summary: 1) Hotfix the rotation handshake to ensure atomic flip semantics where new envelope is only published after all nodes accept it. 2) Add a forced RBAC cache invalidation and session reconciliation step to the rotation path. 3) Tighten audit logger schema validation to drop into a dead-letter queue (DLQ) instead of quietly failing, and implement a reprocessor to backfill rejected messages into tenant audit stores. 4) Add canary + rollout plan and telemetry to detect reoccurrence.
deployment_plan: Build hotfix branch and run unit + integration tests against on-prem KMS emulator (ENG-30789-hotfix)
Canary rollout to 2 non-production private clusters in staging using runtime-1.22 branch
After 24h stability, incrementally roll to 3 customer clusters with low traffic then to remaining affected clusters
Execute session-reconciliation job in maintenance window (see runbook link) to clean up orphaned sessions
Run audit-backfill reprocessor to ingest DLQ messages and reconcile tenant audit stores
rollback_plan: If canary shows increased 5xx/401 rate, revert to previous control-plane binary, re-apply RBAC TTL bypass to restore session acceptance, and pause automated rotations until manual admin rotation can be coordinated with affected customers.
qa_notes: Added integration test that simulates staggered node commits during rotation and verifies no session invalidation
Manual test: simulate rotation with real HSM emulator and verify audit reprocessor recovers DLQ entries
Rerun customer-reported reproduction with patched control-plane in staging
